display_long_description:
Holosweat is an interactive workout app that lets you enjoy your favorite online content while exercising. This comes with an adjustable browser you can use while working out. It's conveniently positioned so you can interact with it without having to aim.

The app combines virtual experiences with passthrough, seamlessly switching between the two based on what you're doing in your workout.

Holosweat comes with virtual trainers who guide you throughout your workout. They not only explain and demonstrate the exercises but also perform them with you. This way, you always know what exercise comes next and how to do it.

In addition, Holosweat is integrated with heart rate monitors, displaying your heart rate on screen as you exercise. Alongside this, the app's built-in statistics system helps you track your performance and progress, providing you with valuable insights into your fitness journey.
